name: How long does a shingle roof replacement typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a shingle roof replacement typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shingle roof replacement depends on several factors, including the size and complexity of your roof, weather conditions, and the crew size. For an average-sized residential home, the process typically takes between 2 to 5 days from start to finish. This includes removing old shingles, making any necessary deck repairs, installing new underlayment, and laying down the new shingles.
acceptedAnswer.description: A shingle roof replacement for an average home usually takes 2 to 5 days, depending on roof size and weather.
